build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet18 model with a specified number of classes for CIFAR-10 image classification
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet50 model using Bottleneck blocks for CIFAR-10 image classification
create_basicblock_layer: create a BasicBlock residual layer with two 3x3 convolutions and a shortcut connection
create_bottleneck_layer: create a Bottleneck residual layer with three convolutions and a 4x expansion ratio
run_resnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a ResNet model to classify input image tensors
